title:
What is the Cost to Start a Mobile Dog Grooming Business vs. a Franchi
 – Vanspeed PRO

facts.fact: The Vanspeed PRO article is dated July 1, 2026.
The vendor states that independent mobile grooming businesses have no royalty payments, no franchise restrictions, and no corporate approvals required for every decision.
facts.quote: There are no royalty payments. No franchise restrictions. No corporate approvals required for every decision.

facts.fact: The vendor lists initial franchise fees, royalty payments, marketing fees, technology fees, and renewal costs as costs franchise owners may be responsible for, depending on the franchise.
facts.quote: Depending on the franchise, owners may be responsible for:

facts.fact: The vendor states that franchise ongoing costs continue regardless of how successful the business becomes.
facts.quote: These expenses continue regardless of how successful the business becomes.

facts.fact: The vendor states that as revenue grows, many franchise fees also grow.
facts.quote: As revenue grows, so do many of these fees.

facts.fact: The vendor states that franchise investments often require similar upfront investment to mobile grooming, plus franchise fees and recurring royalty obligations.
facts.quote: franchise opportunities often require similar investments — plus franchise fees and recurring royalty obligations.

facts.fact: The vendor lists the items a mobile dog grooming startup needs: a reliable van, a professional conversion, insurance, equipment, branding, and marketing.
facts.quote: You will need a reliable van, a professional conversion, insurance, equipment, branding, and marketing.

facts.fact: The vendor states that mobile grooming startup spending primarily builds equity in assets the owner keeps, such as the vehicle, equipment, and brand.
facts.quote: With mobile grooming, your investment primarily builds equity in assets you own

facts.fact: The vendor states that independent mobile grooming businesses can change services, service areas, and pricing in response to customer demand without franchisor approval.
facts.quote: Independent mobile grooming businesses have the freedom to evolve in response to customer demand.
